tools.name: get_wallet_address

tools.name: get_chain_info

network.description: Network name (e.g., 'ethereum', 'optimism', 'arbitrum', 'base') or chain ID. Defaults to Ethereum mainnet.

tools.name: get_supported_networks
tools.description: Get a list of all supported EVM networks

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: resolve_ens_name
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name to an Ethereum address

network.description: Network name or chain ID. ENS resolution works best on Ethereum mainnet. Defaults to Ethereum mainnet.

tools.name: lookup_ens_address
tools.description: Lookup the ENS name for an Ethereum address (reverse resolution)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get block details by block number or hash

blockIdentifier.description: Block number (as string) or block hash

includeTransactions.description: Include full transaction list. Defaults to false (returns only transactionCount).

includeBurnedFee.description: Include EIP-1559 burnedFee (wei+ether). Default false — set true when analyzing network burn.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_latest_block
tools.description: Get the latest block from the network

includeTransactions.description: Include full transaction list. Defaults to false (returns only transactionCount).

includeBurnedFee.description: Include EIP-1559 burnedFee (wei+ether). Default false — set true when analyzing network burn.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the native token balance (ETH, MATIC, etc.) for an address

address.description: The wallet address or ENS name

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get the ERC20 token balance for an address

address.description: The wallet address or ENS name

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_allowance
tools.description: Check ERC20 allowance granted to a spender.

spenderAddress.description: The address allowed to spend the token (usually a contract address)

ownerAddress.description: The owner address (defaults to the configured wallet)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by transaction hash

includeTimestamp.description: Set to true to include block timestamp in MSK (adds +1 RPC call). Use when user asks about transaction time.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Get transaction receipt (status, gas, logs with auto-decoded events).

includeTimestamp.description: Set to true to include block timestamp in MSK (adds +1 RPC call). Use when user asks about transaction time.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: wait_for_transaction
tools.description: Wait for transaction confirmation (polls until mined).

confirmations.description: Number of block confirmations required. Defaults to 1.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_transaction_trace
tools.description: Tenderly trace: internal calls, state changes, gas, decoded events. summary=true for compact. Requires TENDERLY_RPC_URLS.

summary.description: Compact: status/gas/logs/assetChanges/balanceChanges/exposureChanges only, drops trace[] and stateChanges[]. Default false.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: decode_transaction_input
tools.description: Decode calldata to function name + args via Tenderly (no ABI needed). Requires TENDERLY_RPC_URLS.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Token price from CoinGecko by ticker (ETH, BTC) or ID (ethereum). Returns price + 24h change.

token.description: Token ticker (ETH, BTC, USDC, LINK, UNI, etc.) or CoinGecko ID (ethereum, bitcoin, usd-coin)

vsCurrency.description: Currency to get price in. Defaults to 'usd'. Supports: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, cny, etc.

tools.name: get_address_history
tools.description: Address history via Etherscan. `address` is the PARTICIPANT (holder/sender/receiver), NOT the token contract — for collection-wide transfers use `get_logs` instead. type: 'native' / 'internal' / 'erc20' / 'erc721' / 'erc1155'. Optional `contractAddress` narrows to a specific token. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

contractAddress.description: Filter by specific token/NFT contract (ignored for native/internal)

tools.name: find_recent_calls
tools.description: Recent successful txs to a contract grouped by selector, with per-slot calldata samples + type hints. For reverse-engineering ABIs of unverified contracts. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

address.description: Contract address (the recipient of the txs to analyze)

selector.description: 4-byte selector (0x...) to filter by. If omitted, returns top selectors by call count.

samplesPerSelector.description: Per-slot sample values to show per selector group (default 3, max 10)

includeInternal.description: Also pull `txlistinternal` (calls reaching the contract via another contract — aggregators, multicall, automation). Two Etherscan requests; merged by hash.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Fetch verified contract ABI from Etherscan. For proxies (resolveProxy=true default): returns `abi` as merged UNION of proxy-shell + impl ABIs (impl wins on selector collision) — contains both business-logic and admin functions. Also exposes raw proxyAbi/implAbi/proxyInfo. Use `abi` directly for function lookups on proxy addresses. `implAbiFetchFailed:true` = impl unverified, falls back to proxy-only. resolveProxy=false → raw proxy-fasade only. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

resolveProxy.description: Auto-resolve proxy → merged ABI (default true). False = raw proxy-fasade only.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum). Use get_supported_networks for full list.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call view functions on a contract. Auto-fetches ABI (proxy-aware) or uses common ERC20 signatures. On revert auto-decodes the error via fallback cascade and returns a structured `revert` object. IMPORTANT: returnDataLength:4 + classification 'method_not_found_or_bare_revert' means the function likely doesn't exist on the target — NOT a custom error, even if openchain matched a name.

args.description: Function arguments as strings (e.g., ['0xAddress'] for balanceOf)

abiJson.description: Full contract ABI as JSON string (optional - will auto-fetch verified contract ABI if not provided)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

from.description: Caller address for the eth_call. Set for functions that depend on msg.sender (whitelist checks, per-wallet limits).

blockNumber.description: Block: number, hex, or tag (latest/pending/earliest/safe/finalized). Default latest.

value.description: ETH value to attach (in ether, e.g. '0.1'). Useful for payable view-like calls.

stateOverride.description: Per-account state overrides applied before the call (test 'what if X were Y'). Same shape as simulate_call.

tools.name: write_contract
tools.description: Call state-changing contract functions. Auto-fetches ABI. DRY_RUN default — pass confirm='CONFIRMED' to execute. Requires EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

value.description: ETH value to send with transaction in ether (e.g., '0.1' for payable functions)

abiJson.description: Full contract ABI as JSON string (optional - will auto-fetch verified contract ABI if not provided)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

confirm.description: 'DRY_RUN' (default, simulates with gas estimate) or 'CONFIRMED' (executes). Mainnet always blocked.

nonce.description: Explicit nonce. Omit to auto-allocate. Set manually for replace-by-fee.

maxFeePerGasGwei.description: EIP-1559 max fee per gas (gwei, decimal).

tools.name: send_raw_transaction
tools.description: Broadcast a pre-signed raw transaction. DRY_RUN default decodes without sending. Bypasses the per-wallet nonce manager and DRY_RUN simulation — caller is responsible for the bytes.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum). Must match the chainId signed into the raw tx.

tools.name: multicall
tools.description: Batch multiple contract reads into one RPC via Multicall3. Reduces latency for portfolio/price queries.

abiJson.description: Contract ABI as JSON string (optional - will auto-fetch if not provided)

calls.description: Array of contract calls to batch together

allowFailure.description: If true, returns partial results even if some calls fail. Defaults to true.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: transfer_native
tools.description: Send native tokens (ETH/MATIC/etc). DRY_RUN default — pass confirm='CONFIRMED' to execute.

amount.description: Amount to send in ether (e.g., '0.5' for 0.5 ETH)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

confirm.description: 'DRY_RUN' (default, simulates with gas estimate) or 'CONFIRMED' (executes). Mainnet always blocked.

nonce.description: Explicit nonce. Omit to auto-allocate. Set manually for replace-by-fee.

gasPriceGwei.description: Legacy gasPrice override (gwei, decimal). Use instead of maxFee for non-EIP-1559 chains.

maxFeePerGasGwei.description: EIP-1559 max fee per gas (gwei, decimal).

tools.name: transfer_erc20
tools.description: Send ERC20 tokens. DRY_RUN default — pass confirm='CONFIRMED' to execute.

amount.description: Amount to send (in token units, accounting for decimals)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

confirm.description: 'DRY_RUN' (default, simulates with gas estimate) or 'CONFIRMED' (executes). Mainnet always blocked.

nonce.description: Explicit nonce. Omit to auto-allocate. Set manually for replace-by-fee.

maxFeePerGasGwei.description: EIP-1559 max fee per gas (gwei, decimal).

tools.name: approve_token_spending
tools.description: Approve ERC20 spender (for DEX/lending). DRY_RUN default — pass confirm='CONFIRMED'. Use infinite=true for max approval.

spenderAddress.description: The address that will be allowed to spend tokens (usually a contract)

amount.description: Amount to approve in token units. Use '0' to revoke. Required unless infinite=true.

infinite.description: Shortcut for max uint256 (unlimited approval). If true, overrides amount. Common for DEX/lending protocols.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

confirm.description: 'DRY_RUN' (default, simulates with gas estimate) or 'CONFIRMED' (executes). Mainnet always blocked.

nonce.description: Explicit nonce. Omit to auto-allocate. Set manually for replace-by-fee.

maxFeePerGasGwei.description: EIP-1559 max fee per gas (gwei, decimal).

tools.name: get_nft_info
tools.description: Get ERC721 NFT metadata URI + optionally fetch the referenced JSON (http/https only — IPFS skipped).

resolveMetadata.description: If true, fetch the tokenURI JSON and include name/image/description. Works only for http/https URIs (not ipfs://).

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: nft_recent_activity
tools.description: Summarize recent NFT collection transfers. ERC721 by default; pass `standard:'erc1155'` for TransferSingle/TransferBatch. Mints (from=0x0) excluded by default — they don't prove secondary-market liquidity. Returns `transferCount`, `mintCount`, `uniqueHolders`, and a trimmed list of recent transfers.

blocks.description: Blocks back from latest to scan. Default 10000 (~33h on Ethereum). RECOMMENDED: 200-1000 on free-tier Alchemy, 10000+ on premium RPC. Larger = minutes of sequential chunks on free tier.

excludeMints.description: Filter out mints (from=zero). Default true — mints don't indicate secondary-market transferability.

limit.description: Max transfers to return in the response (summary stats always reflect full count). Default 50.

chunkSize.description: Block-range chunk size for eth_getLogs. Default 10 (matches Alchemy free-tier).

maxChunks.description: Safety cap on chunk count. Default 1000 (enough for 10k blocks at chunkSize=10).

requestDelayMs.description: Delay between chunked RPC calls. Default 50ms (safe for Alchemy free tier).

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: nft_check_transferability
tools.description: Classify NFT transferability for ERC721 and ERC1155 (auto-detected via ERC-165). Cascade: simulate transfer → probe TransferValidator allowlist (ERC721 only) → inspect recent Transfer logs to confirm/override. Classifications: 'open' / 'marketplace_only' / 'frozen' / 'likely_soulbound' / 'inconclusive'. inconclusive ⇒ transferable=null. Direct on-chain transfer evidence overrides simulation failure.

tokenId.description: TokenId for simulation. If omitted: log cascade → ownerOf(1) → ownerOf(0) → totalSupply probe.

blocks.description: Blocks to scan for secondary transfers. Default 10000 (~33h on Ethereum). RECOMMENDED: 200-500 on free-tier RPC (Alchemy) to avoid rate-limit delays; 10000+ on premium RPC. Wider = higher confidence but minutes of chunked requests on free tier.

knownOperators.description: Custom marketplace operator addresses to probe. Overrides built-in list (OpenSea/Blur/LooksRare/X2Y2) for niche chains/marketplaces.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_erc1155_balance
tools.description: Get ERC1155 token balance for an address

address.description: The owner address or ENS name

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Query event logs with auto-decode of 47+ events (ERC20/721/1155 transfers + Mint/Burn, major DEX/lending/marketplace, flash loans). Pass `eventSignature` for auto-topic0. Returns `eventSummary` + logs. Free-tier RPCs cap `eth_getLogs` range at ~10 blocks — `autoChunk: 'onError'` (default) retries wide queries chunked, with rate-limit backoff. On partial failure returns `partialScan:true` + `failedRanges` — prefer partial over all-or-nothing.

eventSignature.description: Event signature e.g. 'Transfer(address,address,uint256)' — topic0 auto-computed. Ignored if topics is set.

topics.description: Topic filters. topic[0] = event hash. null = wildcard. Takes priority over eventSignature.

toBlock.description: Ending block number (as string) or 'latest'. Defaults to 'latest'.

limit.description: Max logs to return (default 100). Extra logs are dropped but totalCount and eventSummary still reflect the full result.

verbose.description: Keep raw topics/data even when decoded is present. Default false (drops raw — info already in decoded.args).

autoChunk.description: Wide-range behavior. 'onError' (default) single call → chunk on range error. 'always' chunks from start. 'never' fails on range error.

chunkSize.description: Blocks per chunk (default 10, matches Alchemy free-tier).

maxChunks.description: Max chunks (default 50, → 500 blocks at chunkSize=10). Exceeding throws.

requestDelayMs.description: Ms between chunks for RPC pacing (default 50, safe for Alchemy free).

maxRetriesPerChunk.description: Max 429/CU retries per chunk, exp backoff 500/1000/2000ms (default 3).

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas + cost in ETH for a transaction without sending it.

value.description: ETH value to send in ether (e.g., '0.1')

from.description: Sender address (optional, uses configured wallet if not set)

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: compute_selector
tools.description: Compute the selector / topic hash for a function/error/event signature locally (keccak256, no RPC). Input: canonical ('transfer(address,uint256)') or full Solidity ('function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)'). Output: events → 32-byte topic0; functions/errors → 4-byte selector.

signature.description: Canonical 'transfer(address,uint256)' or full Solidity 'function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)'.

kind.description: Kind of signature. 'function'/'error' return first 4 bytes (selector). 'event' returns full 32-byte hash (topic0).

tools.name: encode_calldata
tools.description: Build ABI-encoded calldata from a function signature + args (no RPC). Returns 0x<selector><encoded>. Symmetric to decode_transaction_input.

signature.description: Canonical 'transfer(address,uint256)' or full Solidity 'function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)'.

args.description: Function arguments as strings. Numerics accept decimal or hex; addresses must be 0x-prefixed; bytes/bytesN must be hex.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Get bytecode at address. Classifies as EOA / EIP-7702 delegated / contract. `summary: true` returns stats only; `saveTo: <abs path>` writes bytecode to disk — both avoid hex-dump bloat for large contracts.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

summary.description: If true, drop the full bytecode from the response and return only classification + size + first/last 32 bytes. Recommended for contracts >50KB to avoid context bloat.

saveTo.description: Absolute file path to write the bytecode to (e.g. '/tmp/contract.hex'). Parent directory must exist. Response then includes only the path + stats; full hex is on disk.

tools.name: get_proxy_implementation
tools.description: Detect if address is a proxy and return implementation. Supports EIP-1967 (Transparent/UUPS), EIP-1967 Beacon, EIP-1167 Minimal Proxy, EIP-1822 UUPS.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_storage_at
tools.description: Read raw storage slot at address. Returns 32-byte hex value. For analyzing unverified contracts or EIP-1967 slots.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

blockNumber.description: Block: number, hex, or tag (latest/pending/earliest/safe/finalized). Default latest.

tools.name: read_storage_batch
tools.description: Read multiple storage slots in parallel. Pass `slots` (explicit list) or `start`+`count` (sequential range). All target the same block. Cap 256 slots. `decode: true` adds typeHint + decoded value per slot (string/address/uint heuristics).

start.description: Range mode: starting slot (hex or decimal). Use with `count`.

count.description: Range mode: number of sequential slots to read starting from `start`.

decode.description: If true, add `typeHint` + `decoded` per slot (single-value heuristics: address shape, Solidity short string, uint size buckets).

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

blockNumber.description: Block: number, hex, or tag (latest/pending/earliest/safe/finalized). Default latest.

tools.name: wait_for_storage_value
tools.description: Poll a storage slot until match. `expected` for exact value or `change: true` for any change from current. Returns matched value + elapsed, or times out.

expected.description: Expected value (32-byte hex). Returns when slot equals this. Mutually exclusive with `change`.

change.description: If true, captures current value at start and returns when slot differs. Mutually exclusive with `expected`.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_contract_interfaces
tools.description: Detect ERC-165 supported interfaces on a contract (ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-2981 royalty, AccessControl, Seaport, etc.).

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_token_metadata
tools.description: Comprehensive token analysis in one call: name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, proxy status + implementation, verified status. Useful for unknown tokens.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_contract_source
tools.description: Verified Solidity source + metadata via Etherscan. Filters to avoid huge multi-file dumps: `index:true` (file list only), `files:[paths]` (selected files), `grep:'needle'` (matching lines + context from all files). `fields`: 'minimal' / 'metadata' / 'full'. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

fields.description: Response scope: 'minimal' (name, compiler, proxy status only), 'metadata' (all except SourceCode), 'full' (default, complete).

index.description: Return file list only (path/lines/bytes, no content). Fastest preview before grepping.

files.description: Return content of only these files (substring match on path). Example: ['Token.sol', 'MyValidator']. Case-sensitive.

grep.description: Search pattern (substring by default, regex:true for regex). Returns matching lines ±contextLines of context.

regex.description: Treat `grep` as a regex. Default false (plain substring).

contextLines.description: Lines of context before+after each grep match. Default 5.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: get_contract_creation
tools.description: Get contract creator address and creation tx hash via Etherscan. Up to 5 addresses per call. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description: Tenderly simulate with full trace + asset/balance changes + logs. PREFER {functionName, args, abiJson?} over raw `data` to avoid calldata bugs. On revert always returns `revert:{decodedInput, firstRevertedCall, revertClassification, topLevelRevert}`. Auto-falls back to native eth_call when Tenderly does not support the chain — that mode loses trace/assets/logs.

from.description: Sender address (tool warns if this is a contract — msg.sender-gated checks may diverge from a real tx).

data.description: Raw calldata (hex, 0x...). Mutually exclusive with functionName — prefer functionName for anything non-trivial.

functionName.description: Function to call (e.g. 'transferFrom'). ABI auto-fetched (proxy-aware) unless abiJson set.

args.description: Args for functionName. JS-native types; use strings for uint256 to avoid JS precision loss.

abiJson.description: ABI JSON for encoding functionName. If omitted, merged proxy+impl ABI is auto-fetched.

blockNumber.description: Block for historical simulation (decimal or 0x-hex, default 'latest').

summary.description: Compact: status/gas/logs/assetChanges/balanceChanges only, drops trace[] and stateChanges[]. Revert fields always included on failure. Default false.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

tools.name: simulate_call
tools.description: Native eth_call (no Tenderly). Supports `stateOverride` to fake balance/nonce/code/storage before the call. Returns success+returnData or revert cascade. No trace/asset/log changes — use simulate_transaction for those.

from.description: Caller address (msg.sender). Defaults to the zero address.

data.description: Raw calldata hex (0x...). Mutually exclusive with functionName.

functionName.description: Function to call. ABI auto-fetched (proxy-aware) unless abiJson set. Return value will be decoded if ABI is available.

abiJson.description: ABI JSON for encoding functionName + decoding return.

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

blockNumber.description: Block: number, hex, or tag (latest/pending/earliest/safe/finalized). Default latest.

stateOverride.description: Per-account state overrides applied before the call.

state.description: Replace ENTIRE storage (all other slots become zero)

stateDiff.description: Override only these slots; leave others intact

skipBalanceCheck.description: Auto-fund the `from` account via stateOverride.balance so RPCs don't pre-reject payable calls with 'insufficient funds'. Has no effect if you already supply a stateOverride entry for `from`.

tools.name: decompile_local
tools.description: Decompile a contract's bytecode via locally-installed heimdall (needs heimdall in PATH or HEIMDALL_PATH). Raw passthrough — heimdall is known to mistype bytes/array args as uint256 and emit spurious require(msg.value); verify with find_recent_calls.

address.description: Contract address whose bytecode to decompile

network.description: Network name or chain ID (default: ethereum)

outputMode.description: Trim heimdall output to fit LLM context. 'selectors' (~1 KB): just selector→name list. 'abi_only' (~10 KB): parsed ABI without decompiled.sol. 'full' (default, can be 80+ KB): everything.

extraArgs.description: Additional CLI args passed verbatim to heimdall (e.g. ['--include-yul'])

timeoutMs.description: Max runtime in ms (default 90000, capped at 600000)

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: Sign message with configured wallet (for SIWE auth, off-chain signatures).

message.description: The message to sign (plain text or hex-encoded data)

tools.name: sign_typed_data
tools.description: Sign EIP-712 typed data with configured wallet (permits, meta-txs).

domainJson.description: EIP-712 domain as JSON string with fields: name, version, chainId, verifyingContract, salt (all optional)

typesJson.description: EIP-712 types definition as JSON string (exclude EIP712Domain type - it's added automatically)

messageJson.description: The message data to sign as JSON string

tools.name: verify_signature
tools.description: Verify that a signature was created by the given address for the given message. Returns boolean.

address.description: Address that allegedly signed the message

message.description: The original message that was signed
